latex.exported: {file}: main.tex, the references and the images. Compile with latexmk -lualatex (or -xelatex).
latex.missingKeys: Not in any .bib in the vault: {keys}
latex.pdf.web: PDF from LaTeX needs the desktop app with Tectonic installed (tectonic-typesetting.github.io). In the browser, export the LaTeX project and compile it yourself.
latex.pdf.noTectonic: Tectonic is not installed. Install it (brew install tectonic, or tectonic-typesetting.github.io), or set LUMEN_TECTONIC to its path, then try again.
latex.pdf.consent.title: Let Tectonic download TeX packages?
latex.pdf.consent.message: Tectonic, the TeX engine you installed, downloads its TeX support files and any package it lacks from its bundle server ({host}). That request carries your IP address and the package names, never the document. You are asked once; each compile that may download is listed in the privacy ledger. In airplane mode or under local-only, Tectonic uses only the packages it already has.
